title: Specify match rules and verify default parameters
lead: Specify the match: config fields, seeded placement, turn order, cycle limit, tie rule and result. Verify the recommended default parameters against a cited source.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** tournament scoring, replay format, implementation.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goals 3 and 4 need a deterministic match with a defined tie rule. The recommended defaults (core 8000, cycles 80000, max processes 8000) are from general knowledge and must be checked against a source (C24).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - `docs/spec/match.md` (new; final path per the scaffolding layout).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: None (document). The spec includes worked placement examples for fixed seeds that the arena slice turns into tests.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Config fields from the data model: core size, cycle limit, max processes, min separation, seed.
- Placement: random non-overlapping start positions from the seed, honoring min separation. Specify the RNG algorithm exactly and implement it in-repo later, so native and WASM builds agree; define the error when placement is impossible.
- Turn: each live bot executes one instruction from the front of its queue, then requeues it; a bot with no processes is dead. Define bot order within a cycle and what one cycle counts.
- Result: winner, survivors at the cycle limit, cycles run.
- Gap: PROJECT.md requires "a defined tie rule" but gives none. Propose options to the owner.
- Gap: PROJECT.md gives no default min separation. Propose one to the owner.
- Verify the three defaults against a public source (ICWS'94 text or hill documentation); cite it in the spec; record the confirmed defaults as a catalog decision.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Every config field has a default and, where it comes from Redcode norms, a cited source.
- The tie rule and min separation are owner-confirmed.
- `slicer catalog list --kind decision --json --lean` includes the confirmed defaults.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-match-spec` in `.worktrees/<id>`. Document only. One commit when the owner asks.
